source: can you make a game were you spawn in a big giant building and make it so when you turn to your left there is a summoning era were it cost 100$ to summon and add characters you can get like a spekerman from skibidi toilet and make him a common rarity and make him a 55% chance also add a guy called tv man that is a uncommon rarity that is 35% chance and a large cameraman from skibidi toilet then can you add a inventory bouton were you can equip your units that you rolled also can you add a telleporter that can fit 5 people in it and when you go in it there will be a start bouton to start it amedeitley then once you spawn in there will be a city but like a tiny one but you are like a little smaller then it the there be a path way where one side there will be a base called camera base then the over side of the path will be were the toilets from skibidi toilet spawn and at the top there will be a wave thing that tells you what wave you are on there will be 10 waves 1st wave will spawn 6 small skibidi toilets from skibidi toilet wave 2 will be 10 small skibidi toilets from skibidi toilet wave 3 will be 12 small skibidi toilets from skibidi toilet and a medium toilet then wave 4 will be 12 small skibidi toilets and 2 medium skibidi toilets then wave 5 you know each time it will get harder and harder until you get to wave ten and wave ten will be boss toilet oh yeah wave 5 to 7 will have large toilets then wave 8 to 9 will have big skibidi toilets ok now your units you can place down will have upgradeds and speaker man will have level 1 damage 30 range 10 ok and when you beat the waves it will give you 100$ oh yeah and by killing toilets it will give you cash to upgrade your units and also cameraman will be a starter unit you start with when you join the game

answers.ask: How big is the tiny city - one street with the base at the end, or several blocks?
answers.answer: Make it one small city street with the Camera Base on one side of the pathway and the toilets spawning from the other side.

answers.ask: Is the spawn building a separate map you teleport out of, or is it attached to the city?
answers.answer: The big spawn building should be a separate lobby map, and the teleporter takes players into the city match.

answers.ask: The teleporter fits five - is the whole run five players co-operating on one lane?
answers.answer: Yes, up to five players should play together co-operatively on the same lane for all 10 waves.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: How big is the tiny city - one street with the base at the end, or several blocks? A: Make it one small city street with the Camera Base on one side of the pathway and the toilets spawning from the other side.
- [author] shape — Q: Is the spawn building a separate map you teleport out of, or is it attached to the city? A: The big spawn building should be a separate lobby map, and the teleporter takes players into the city match.
- [author] players — Q: The teleporter fits five - is the whole run five players co-operating on one lane? A: Yes, up to five players should play together co-operatively on the same lane for all 10 waves.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a stylized cooperative tower-defense game split between a giant indoor lobby and a separate miniature-city match map. In the lobby, orient the spawn so a summoning area is immediately to the player's left. Place one large teleporter platform elsewhere in the room, visibly sized for exactly five players, with a physical start button. The match is one small city street with buildings only somewhat taller than the players. Run one continuous enemy pathway from an absurd bathroom-themed enemy entrance at one end to a camera-themed technology base at the other. Leave flat defender-placement strips on both sides of the street and add one simple pinch point along the route. Use original audiovisual-device defenders and surreal bathroom enemies without copying protected franchise characters or assets.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Strategy, canonical slug `strategy`, because five players place and upgrade units to defend a core against ten scripted waves.

## Shape and preset
Use `space-staged`, taken from outside Strategy's usual shapes, as a Lobby and Isolated Stage containing the separate spawn building and city match. The match segment uses `lane-actor-track`. Match the Tower Defense preset for the valid enemy lane, placement grid, core base, enemy origin, and pinch point.

## Config requirements
Use `spawn-first-reveal` so lobby arrivals face forward with the summoning area clearly visible on the left. Use `social-hub` for the large lobby room; `teleporter-link` for the five-person lobby-to-match platform; `buildzone-grid` for placement strips beside the city street; `tracker-core` for the camera-themed base; and `choke-bottleneck` for one narrowing in the enemy lane.

## Layout requirements
Place one free-text TriggerZone at the summoning area and one at the teleporter's start button. Place the layout half of `teleporter-link` on the five-person lobby platform and at the match arrival. Place exactly five SpawnZone slots near the defended base. Place one `spawner-npc` at the opposite end of the street for all ten waves. Place the layout half of `tracker-core` on the defended base. Unit rarity, summon odds, inventory, damage, upgrades, cash, wave counts, and enemy counts are gameplay data.

## Layout components
The top-level container has two map segments: Spawn Building, one giant interior room with oriented spawn, left-side summoning area, and five-person teleporter; and Tiny City Match, one miniature street with one continuous lane, flanking build zones, a defended technology base, one enemy mouth, one pinch point, and nearby low city buildings.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: establish the single unbroken enemy lane and all placement strips first, then dress both maps isometrically; the plan is authoritative because a broken or ambiguous wave path would make tower defense fail, while no supported authored blueprint exists for this lane type.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use medium scale so lobby stations and the miniature street remain legible in their separate frames. The theme is stylized surreal technology-versus-bathroom tower defense with original assets. Use `P4` for the separate lobby and match maps and `P6` because the enemy lane must be valid by construction.
